summary: Backend-only test of the NEW clinician Session Mode endpoints (POST/GET/GET-by-id/DELETE /api/sessions). Created /app/backend/tests/test_sessions.py with 11 tests covering auth gating, payload validation, full CRUD lifecycle, summary aggregation (per-activity totals + cue_types breakdown), accuracy_pct correctness (50% / None when zero attempts), SOAP-Objective generation via Claude, multi-activity aggregation, and cross-user isolation. All 11 tests passed in ~21s against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is approaching ~660 lines; consider splitting routes by domain (auth, content, llm, sessions) into separate routers for maintainability before more endpoints are added.

POST /api/sessions performs the Claude SOAP call inline (10-30s latency). For better UX, consider returning the saved doc immediately and generating SOAP asynchronously, OR streaming. Current sync path is fine but blocks the request and the worker for the full Claude duration.
Pydantic v2 deprecation: @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; switch to FastAPI lifespan handlers.

Set FRONTEND_URL has a hardcoded 'http://localhost:3000' default in code AND is also added to allow_origins separately - acceptable but per system rules .env defaults shouldn't be hardcoded in code (low priority since FRONTEND_URL is also read from env).

_summarize_session uses activity_title/started_at from the FIRST attempt or cue when no matching activity entry exists; if attempts arrive before an activity entry but with a different title casing, slug-collisions may produce stale titles. Not a bug for current payload, but worth a comment.
test_credentials: Historical shared credentials removed; current live tests require explicit environment configuration.
seed_data_creation: Tests create sessions with TEST_ prefixed names and delete them on teardown. One TEST_other_<hex>@example.com user is registered to verify cross-user isolation; that user is left in the DB (small footprint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Session endpoints fully verified end-to-end including SOAP generation via Claude Sonnet 4.5 (live LLM call). Existing /app/backend/tests/test_concentric.py covers auth/content/tts/transcribe/generate-scenario. To re-run only the new suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sessions.py -v. Frontend (SessionBanner, /sessions, /sessions/:id) was not tested per request.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found; all 11 backend tests passed.
